title: Passkey Name Prompt
summary: Prefills a distinct name right after a passkey is created, so the security page isn't a list of identical "Passkey" rows nobody can tell apart.
description: Post-creation passkey naming prompt that prefills a distinct name from the AAGUID (iCloud Keychain, 1Password) or the device ("Mac · Chrome", phone, security key), numbers it when taken, blocks empty and duplicate names, nudges away from generic ones, and says whether it syncs.
catches: Empty or duplicate names, with a one-tap fix
Provider from the AAGUID, or device from the user agent
Whether the passkey syncs (manager) or stays on this device
limits: Display only, never a trust decision; AAGUIDs can be zeroed or spoofed
Built-in AAGUID table is small; pass providers for others
a11y: Visible label; input has aria-invalid when blocked and is described by a polite status
stops: Identical passkeys nobody can tell apart
mistakes: cant tell which passkey to delete
